description: JSON Schema validating agent-config/tools.json and agent-config/pipeline.json for UI editing

name.description: Unique tool identifier, lowercase with underscores

description.description: Short description shown to the LLM

terminal.description: If true, calling this tool ends the pipeline

handler.description: Execution method: 'bridge' proxies to Python backend, 'direct' calls external APIs

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema defining the tool's arguments (OpenAI function-calling format)
